title: Remote Sensing Applications IRS Systems
definition: India's indigenous Remote Sensing (IRS) satellite series, managed by ISRO, constitutes one of the largest civilian remote sensing satellite constellations in the world, providing multi-spectral, multi-resolution data for Earth observation, resource management, and disaster governance.
importanceInUpsc: Highly critical for Prelims (ISRO missions, sensor types, orbits, applications) and Mains GS-3 (Science & Tech - space applications, disaster management, agriculture, security, and GIS governance).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Remote Sensing Applications IRS Systems.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic Indian geography and resource mapping
